checkpoint: Starts on Victory Road 3F (6, 7), where 19.04c ends; 3F's switch is on (start_gates) and so its barrier is open.

3F's boulder (33, 18) pushed into the hole (34, 18) lands on 2F (33, 19); the player follows it down the hole and pushes it west onto 2F's second switch (14, 19), which opens the barrier (33, 16), (33, 17) before 2F's ladder (36, 17). The maps show 2F's boulder from the start; the game hides it until 3F's falls.
Ends on Route 23 (18, 29), facing south, a tile below the cave mouth, where 19.05 starts.
